input:
Kanban card briefs to triage:
1. [ada-alias-telemetry] 91 retired tool names still route via _ALIASES. conversation.log_event already records the emitted name (alias included) — the data exists, nothing aggregates it. Without a deprecation signal the compat layer is permanent and the model never converges on canonical names. Waiting in backlog.
2. [ada-chat-ux-verify] The chat card was rebuilt 2026-10-09: bubbles + timestamps, typing indicator, auto-connect, sticky scroll, status dot. Deployed to ada-ha (?v=6). Needs a human eyeball before we call it done — the open request below is what chaba-nag will keep surfacing until answered.
3. [ada-deploy-gate-tests] Deploy gate should refuse to restart on a broken tree. Today deploy-ada.sh ff-merges and restarts blind — a rebase resolution that silently dropped a 958-line tools.d rewrite only surfaced because its unit test happened to fail locally afterward (2026-10-08 incident). Waiting in backlog.
4. [ada-ocb-skills-edu-postmerge-recheck] Post-merge verification for the ADA-0031 wiki education work: clear the two source-gone flags on lesson-d8b6938588d3.
5. [ada-pi-ci] ada-pi has zero CI. tool-lint and the growing tests/ suite only run when someone remembers; gh-runs-watch already exists in chaba for failure alerts. Waiting in backlog.
6. [ada-toolsd-runner-facade] Drop-ins get `runner` but hand-roll httpx against env URLs — they bypass runner.mddb's leader/follower read-routing (built in mddb_client for 88f22e3-era resilience) and reach runner.context.ha_client informally. Waiting in backlog.
7. [ada-trace-full-result] ws tool_result events run through _safe_args — nested values truncated to 300 chars — so the trace shows a stump while the model saw the full result. A track_device scenario failed on assertions against names that were genuinely in the result (2026-10-07). Waiting in backlog.
8. [ada-voice-host-status-drop-19-pr] Branch feat/host-status-drop-19 (commit 3411665, off ada-voice origin/main 7048cba) is pushed and tested but has no PR: the host has no gh CLI and no GitHub token. Human-owned step.
9. [adobe-stock-render-preview-wiring] Real campaigns need assets.json entries carrying preview_url/thumbnail_url so ada_adobe_stock_reuse renders real thumbnails. Today only the fixture has them.
10. [audit-auto-idc02] Daily audit-hosts diff found service/placement drift on this host. Deltas become work: fix the drift, or fix the SSOT declaration (expected_services, expected_absent, allowed_running, known_failed).
11. [board-diagram-lanes-view] Lane/sub lane diagram of kanban cards per project, starting with Adobe Stock; Tony wants a mental image of project flow and manual control (claim/move/finish) without n8n.
12. [board-tests-control-pane-lane-failures] Six tests/board failures reproduce at base commit and current master (3 control-pane projection, 3 ClaimPassLaneTest). Find the real cause; do not weaken asserts.
13. [budget-watch-ada-dev-2] LiteLLM virtual key ada-dev-2 hit its budget cap: ada-dev-2: $10.004/$10 (100%), reset 2026-12-01 00:00:00 — AT/OVER cap, calls are being 422'd
14. [capture-harvester-apply-gate-1426cfed] The capture router/harvester stay read-only until Tony explicitly approves sink writes. Decide whether to ever enable --apply.
15. [cast-loop-breaker-test-failure] Current master fast pytest gate (python3 -m pytest tests -x -q) fails on tests/ada/test_cast_loop_breaker.py::test_patches_apply_clean — one patch reports diverged.
16. [chaba-exec-checkout-idc02-dirty-files] idc02's exec checkout carries long-lived uncommitted edits re-applied by every hourly repo-sync autostash; pull phase 160s holding the board lock; owner unknown. Needs a per-group commit/move/discard decision.
17. [colab-runtime-identity-and-duplicate-ses-11a426] A second Colab session is possible without the current notebook/MCP knowing. The `colab` MCP controls one attached notebook; `mcp-colab` reports Drive pack state, not account-wide runtime sessions. This risks paying for an idle/duplicate T4 or starting a queue on a CPU runtime.
18. [devin-lane-cheap-ops-reroute] 2026-11-23 devin-lane audit: 36 devin-lane cards seen; explicit=16, kw=7, fallback=9 (conf 0.00). High-confidence devin keyword hits: kw:host (ansible-disk-headure/disk-guard/storage-rebalance/report-graph/render-job-writer) and kw:diagnos (ada-printer-diagnostics).
19. [devin-session-audit-2026-10-29] 304 prior session histories were scanned; external CMS/Drive artifact verification remains. The audit marker is intentionally unchanged.
20. [devin-taskdir-gc-dispatch-hosts] DEV-0044 lever 5. Verified on idc02 2026-11-24: 917 task dirs, no prune timer installed — devin-cleanup declared only for tony-dell/tony-omen, session-prune covers omen sessions.db only.
21. [devnest-ada-mcp-bridge-sync] DevNest local ada-control bridge has the context-pack port plus a large diff vs its old HEAD; canonical ada-voice opencode/ada_mcp.py is the deployed source of truth.
22. [gemini-38-live-extended-thinking-bench-2026-11-26] Run the 20-fixture voice bench plus barge-in and soak probes on the extended-thinking Live variant; compare to the promoted 3.8-live baseline before any pin decision.
23. [idc02-mddb-cors-wildcard-sec-008-set-mdd-1b41a4] Follower logs CORS wildcard at startup; any website can read it from a browser. Low risk on tailnet but should be allowlisted before the port ever escapes.
24. [jack-shared-workspace-repo-promotion] Use the shared Jack OpenCode instance for Tony/Jack collaboration with organized repo workspaces and a gated commit/push/PR flow.
25. [jevnest-kk-mac-capacity-loop] Keep the KK-Mac JevNest productively fed with real bounded read-only work while respecting heartbeat, owner load, disk, and fallback gates.
26. [job-health-sweep-consecutive-failure-alerts] Found 2026-10-30 (KNB-1008 deploy catchup): chaba-audit, mddb-vector-reindex, devin-bank-distill all had ZERO successful finishes in 30d on con01 — nobody knew until a human read journalctl. Dead jobs must surface themselves.
27. [keywatch-or-idc03] Credential monitor flagged or-idc03: OR key sk-or-…735b limit_remaining=0 — bridge dead (the 2026-10-12 failure mode)
28. [keywatch-or-tony-dell] Credential monitor flagged or-tony-dell: OR key sk-or-…735b limit_remaining=0 — bridge dead (the 2026-10-12 failure mode)
29. [keywatch-or-tony-omen] Credential monitor flagged or-tony-omen: OR key sk-or-…5528 rejected (HTTP 401) — fleet inference dies
30. [kk-mac-disk-headroom] KK-Mac has ~20 GB free while 27 GB of duplicated Qwen HF staging occupies the Nest worker cache. Review and reclaim only with Tony approval.
31. [kk-mac-script-smoke] E2E: script executor syncs chaba and runs a bounded repo command on kk-mac under launchd — proves the provisioned runner claims+executes a real kanban card (card kk-mac-launchd-runner-followthrough).
32. [lab-cf-kv-claw-channel] Prove a credential-free edge channel: one KV namespace + one Worker serving claw commands (GET) and ingesting reports (POST w/ thin ingest secret). First real content: a sanitized public board digest readable off-tailnet. Lab — no standard adoption until proven.
33. [lab-gold-thb-causality] An experiment collecting gold, baht, and dollar prices to see which moves first. Data is still gathering — a keep-or-close decision is due 2026-10-18.
34. [lab-meshtastic-th] An experiment listening to the Thai Meshtastic radio mesh and mapping what it hears. Keep-or-close decision due 2026-10-18.
35. [m1-behavioral-fixture-activation-and-skips] OPS-1254 closed with a qualified candidate verdict, not a full frozen-verifier claim. Canonical M1 task still skips its fourth required idle-follower case.
36. [mcp-dell-alphavantage-llama-decision] Two operational declarations absent from tony-dell config; resolve the AUD-0886 allowlist/retire verdict.
37. [mddb-2-15-4-v2-18-10-upgrade-custom-lsn-aa896c] All 5 instances report update available. They run localhost/mddb:*-lsn and *-breaker images — upgrade means rebasing local patches onto 2.18.x and rebuilding, not a pull.
38. [mddb-embed-stale-freebytes-metric-20g-vs-1b600f] /v1/health freeBytes on :11028 is cached from a much earlier disk state; other instances report live values. Minor but could mask a real full-disk.
39. [mddb-ops-30g-analyze-compact-via-mddbd-r-eed976] Native backup copied ~29.7G of 30G file. If most is live docs (host-logs/telemetry) retention pruning is the lever; if freelist, offline -repair-db compaction reclaims it.
40. [mddb-storage-reduction-retention-relocation] idc03 mddb banks total 28G; ops bank alone is 17G because the retention sweep is chained to ada-review-refresh on tony-omen (down for maintenance). Leader host-logs swept (12.8k docs). Ops collection too big to enumerate through live API — backup→scratch-mddb→delete-batch→compact pipeline in flight.
41. [omen-maintenance-preflight-back-up-ha-st-b3738f] Read-only scan 2026-10-25. Omen online, 8 key endpoints HTTP 200; 81GB /home free. Report: gdrive:ada-nest/queue/omen-maintenance-preflight-2026-10-25.md; host audit: reports/audit-hosts/tony-omen-20261025-085345.yml.
42. [opencode-ada-ha-tab-standard] Define and add a protected OpenCode/Ada surface immediately after Board in the Ada HA chaba-admin dashboard, using the same app-tab contract as Board/Cline and a clear Node-RED exception or migration path.
43. [ops-mn01-restore-sshd-shell-script-20261126] Global ForceCommand internal-sftp on mn01 blocks shell SSH and Ansible module execution. Restore the standard host behavior locally.
44. [ops-tony-dell-ssh-restore-diag] Diagnostic follow-up: the first bootstrap run exited 2 in ~4s. Re-run verbosely with all output redirected to /home/tony/ssh-restore-diag.txt so it can be read over SFTP while shell access is still blocked. Exit 0 by design.
45. [ops-tony-dell-ssh-restore-fix] Diagnostic follow-up: the first bootstrap run exited 2 in ~4s. Re-run verbosely with all output redirected to /home/tony/ssh-restore-fix.txt so it can be read over SFTP while shell access is still blocked. Exit 0 by design.
46. [oswe-eval-ada-test-tab] Evaluate OpenSWE/Robin; self-deploy on tony-dell dev-mode, expose like ada-ocb, add 'Ada Test' sidebar tab (OSWE first) on ada-ha chaba-admin.
47. [prune-old-docs-sweep-exits-in-223ms-veri-6e0db7] Timer ran 09:35 status=0 in 223ms — too fast to page 100k+ docs. Ops still holds host-logs docs older than the 3d policy. Either sweep silently no-ops or listing is failing.
48. [release-lifecycle-standard] ssot.release-lifecycle.yml defines the six stages and bars; this card wires enforcement so a release can't skip a gate silently. Umbrella sits under ha-lanes but applies to ada-pi/scripts too.
49. [report-loop-ada-opinion] Part 5 of the report→session loop (umbrella: report-session-loop). Tony asks Ada aloud what she thinks of a report; she reads it, forms a view, and posts it to the card as a from=ada [opinion] comment a running session will see. Queued when Tony presses Start.
50. [report-loop-bench] Part 6 of the report→session loop (umbrella: report-session-loop). Installs the live scenario that catches regressions in Ada's read-report→post-[opinion] loop, and points the nest bench domain at the accruing corpus. Queued when Tony presses Start.
51. [report-loop-comment-delivery] Part 4 of the report→session loop (umbrella: report-session-loop). Today only /respond answers reach a running session; this makes Ada's and Tony's mid-run comments land in the same answers.jsonl — one thread, both voices. Queued when Tony presses Start.
52. [report-loop-session-rails] Part 3 of the report→session loop (umbrella: report-session-loop). When a card carries report:<slug>, its dispatched session gets extra rails: read the report first, mirror progress into the report's session-log, leave it updated. Queued when Tony presses Start.
53. [report-loop-spawn-api] Part 1 of the report→session loop (umbrella: report-session-loop). Makes POST /card able to file an ARMED dispatch card — today it only takes title/note/help, so a CMS "start session" button can't spawn work. Queued when Tony presses Start.
54. [report-loop-spawn-ui] Part 2 of the report→session loop (umbrella: report-session-loop). Adds the visible affordance: a button on Ada's CMS report pages that files an armed kanban card — same effect as asking Ada to dispatch a session. Queued when Tony presses Start.
55. [request-lifecycle] Makes sure your requests don't die inside a chat — they get captured, turned into cards, built, and verified. Waiting in the backlog — no action needed.
56. [runner-auto-queue] action.labels/action.host are hard requirements — a queued card nothing satisfies starves silently. Fix the card's requirements or teach a host the label (RUNNER_LABELS in runner-agent.service + mirror in ssot.kanban.yml runner_fleet).
57. [ssh-access-ansible-standard] Inventory is the declared SSH contract, but ~/.ssh/config and known_hosts are still hand-maintained per controller and push creds are discovered at claim time. Layered fix: declare -> generate -> verify -> bootstrap, with read-only verification first.
58. [unified-media-pack-layout] Generalize the Nest artifact structure so Gaussian, image, video, audio, and document jobs share one Drive dataset/job/pack contract with local scratch processing and immutable manifests.
59. [video-history-data-management] Create one lineage/retention procedure for PDF-to-video sources, plans, derived renders, reviews, final cuts, logs, and model caches.
60. [video-history-opencode-doc] Have Ada/OpenCode independently review and verify the video history data-management procedure.
